name: Shortcut Coach
subtitle: Learn shortcuts as you click
privacyPolicyText: Shortcut Coach processes supported pointer and Accessibility information locally on your Mac to identify a manual action and suggest an equivalent keyboard shortcut. It does not transmit Accessibility snapshots, browsing data, filenames, account information, or coaching history. Preferences and coaching history remain on the Mac and can be cleared in the app. The app has no account, analytics, advertising, or cloud-sync service.
